description.en: A modern WhatsApp Multi-Device library for Node.js, with MessageBuilder and channel support built in.
Install the package, open a connection, and pair a device with a pairing code.
Keep credentials safe across restarts: multi-file, single-file, SQLite, SQL, Mongo, Redis, NekoDB and caching.
Link a device without a QR: server-confirmed requests, one code at a time, and custom codes.
Receive messages, read their text, address users correctly, and send every basic message type.
Interactive messages: buttons, lists, carousels and AIRich rich responses.
Create and run WhatsApp channels: metadata, admins, polls, questions and insights.
Group and community management, participants, and profile pictures.
Complete, runnable bots assembled from the pieces in this documentation.
